verdict.rationale: Mirrors lists LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Pydantic AI, smolagents and Google ADK under "built for your agent's context" and says it "works with any agent framework." It also says it works with traces teams already have. However, the documented setup is installing an npm package and wiring your own prompt and capture hooks, so the logo list is not shown to be a prebuilt drop-in integration. missing for 10: documentation of actual framework integrations or auto-instrumentation (e.g., a LangChain callback handler), any mention of OpenAI SDK or Vercel AI SDK support, setup guides per framework, independent or hands-on corroboration.
